description:
List Instagram Direct conversations in the account's inbox, most recently updated first.

Each entry carries the participant IGSIDs needed to send a message. Requires the messaging permission with Advanced Access.

Example: "any new DMs?" -> limit=10, then instagram_get_conversation on the ones with unread_count > 0

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: instagram_list_conversations
title: List Conversations
